subject: Zenith renewal: premium+ SLO laddering, burst capacity & support playbook
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@zenithfin.com>, Tom Reed <t.reed@zenithfin.com>
Cc: Zenith Procurement <procurement@zenithfin.com>
Date: 2028-07-25T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal conversation — exploring a Premium+ SLA + capacity uplift

Hi Sara / Tom,

Thanks again for the Q2 review call earlier — appreciate the transparency on traffic growth. Zenith's token volume is clearly trending up (great product-market fit!). As we approach your contract renewal window, I wanted to put a pragmatic path on the table that balances predictability for you and cost discipline for Redwood.

High-level ask: Zenith would like a renewal that adds a stronger latency SLO and faster support responsiveness for your latency-sensitive public-facing endpoints, plus a predictable burst capacity cushion during earnings season.

Attached: zenith_usage_report_q2.csv (usage delta), proposed_sla_terms.pdf (initial sketch).

Can you confirm the procurement timeline and whether you'd prefer: (A) a fixed reserved capacity uplift with a monthly commit, or (B) a hybrid reserved + burst plan (baseline reserved + capped usage overage)? We'll draft legal/finance-ready numbers once you confirm preference.

Next step: if you're available next week I'd like to present a single-page Premium+ SLO ladder (p95/p99 targets, P1/P2 response times, runbook/Ops handoff) and the associated cost delta. Could you share a 30-min slot?

Best,
Marissa

Marissa — thanks for putting this together. The timing is right: our renewal window opens mid-August and procurement wants to finalize commercial terms by 08/20.

A couple items we need addressed before we take to finance:
- Concrete latency SLOs (p50/p95/p99) and a description of how tail latency is mitigated (KV cache, prefix caching behavior).
- Support ladder (response/restore targets for P1/P2/P3, on-call handoff details).
- Clear definition of burst capacity (how long, what triggers, cost if used).
- Proof that signing this will not change data residency or audit guarantees.

If you can send a one-page matrix + a sample runbook and PO wording, procurement will be able to review quickly. Tom and I can take a short call on Friday 07/28 — 10:00 PT or 15:00 PT works.

Sara

Subject: RE: Fwd: Zenith renewal — SLO + burst ask (proc timeline 08/20)

Hi team — drafted a compact Premium+ recommendation. Attaching zenith_sla_matrix.xlsx and capacity_proposal_zenith.pdf. Summary below.

Recommended offering: Premium+ (dedicated baseline + burst bucket + priority Ops)
- Availability: 99.9% monthly uptime SLA (with credits laddered at 99.5% and 99.0%).
- Latency SLOs (prod inference path, 99th percentile reported per-region):
  - p50: < 40ms
  - p95: < 120ms
  - p99: < 700ms
- Tail mitigation: prefix/KV cache warm-start, continuous micro-batching disabled for latency-critical routes, dedicated inference pool for pinned model version during business hours.
- Capacity uplift: Recommend baseline reserved capacity = 2.0x current 90-day avg qps for peak-critical model routes; burst bucket = 1.0x baseline for intermittent peak events (automated scale up for up to 6 hours per event).
- Support: Priority response
  - P1 (service down/major degradation): 15-minute initial response, 2-hour incident mitigation target, dedicated escalation channel + named on-call.
  - P2 (severe performance degradation): 1-hour initial response, 8-hour mitigation target.
  - P3 (non-critical): next-business-day response.
- Operational deliverables: shared runbook, monthly SLO report, quarterly ops review, post-incident RCA within 5 business days.
- Credits: tiered financial credits by SLA breach (outlined in attachment).

I'll flag cost deltas in a separate note — Ben, can you confirm the monthly committed cost for baseline 2.0x and burst usage pricing so we can present a clean commercial table?

Priyom
Priyom Das
Director, Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference

Subject: RE: Fwd: Zenith renewal — SLO + burst ask (proc timeline 08/20)

Quick commercial note — rough estimates (rounded):
- Baseline (2.0x reserved) incremental run-rate: +$42k / month.
- Burst bucket (1.0x, capped, pay-per-use above baseline): $0.09 / 1k tokens for overage; with historical peaks we expect 1-2 events per quarter that would draw ~30% of the bucket.
- Premium+ support uplift: +$6k / month (provides named on-call, P1 15m response).
- One-time onboarding + scale testing: $8k.

We can tighten numbers if they opt for a 12-month commit vs. month-to-month. Also recommend auto-burst policy with a hard cap to prevent runaway spend.

Ben

Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

- Estimated delta: +$42k/mo baseline, +$6k/mo support uplift, one-time $8k onboarding.
